Container.Name: Fooocus-cu118
Container.Description: Open source AI image generator (Fooocus) for CUDA 11.8 in Docker. Free, offline SDXL text-to-image with GPU support. Supports Maxwell and newer NVIDIA GPUs.
Container.Overview:
Fooocus is an open-source, offline AI image generator (based on Gradio) that rethinks image generators — prompts and images first, minimal manual tuning. It runs locally on your own NVIDIA GPU with a prebuilt Docker image, so it works on older GPU hardware — including Maxwell and newer cards — that newer images no longer support.
It is offline and private (everything runs on your machine, no cloud needed), free and open source, and includes modern image generation such as inpainting, outpainting, and upscaling. Prompt expansion helps produce better results from simple text, and it requires only 4GB of Nvidia VRAM.
Getting started: install via the Unraid Apps tab, open the web UI, and enter a prompt. The first launch downloads the base model, which can take a while depending on your connection.
Documentation: https://github.com/wildfirebill-ai/Fooocus-cu118

Config.Name: CMDARGS
Config.Description: Arguments passed to launch.py. Keep --listen to bind all interfaces, and --port 7865 for the WebUI.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Container port for the WebUI (fixed at 7865). Change the Default to map a different host port on Unraid.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Persistent storage for models and outputs. Back this folder up to keep your models and image history.

Config.Name: Checkpoints
Config.Description: Path to the Stable Diffusion checkpoints folder. Use 'Import' to seed models from the host on first start.

Config.Name: LoRA
Config.Description: Path to the LoRA models folder.

Config.Name: Embeddings
Config.Description: Path to the textual-inversion embeddings folder.

Config.Name: VAE Approx
Config.Description: Path to the VAE approximation files folder.

Config.Name: Upscale Models
Config.Description: Path to the upscaling models folder.

Config.Name: Inpaint Models
Config.Description: Path to the inpainting models folder.

Config.Name: ControlNet Models
Config.Description: Path to the ControlNet models folder.

Config.Name: CLIP Vision
Config.Description: Path to the CLIP vision models folder.

Config.Name: Prompt Expansion
Config.Description: Path to the Fooocus prompt-expansion model folder.

Config.Name: Outputs
Config.Description: Path to the generated image outputs folder (must stay under /content/app to keep history in the UI).
